descFull: Save up to 30% of your AI coding tokens. Scubiee turns any codebase into searchable context for your AI coding agent. A local context engine for Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, and more: semantic search, code relationships, live sync, MCP integration, and code that never leaves your machine.
